question: List each department name and the number of employees assigned to it, from largest to smallest.
raw_output:
SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(e.emp_no) AS num_employees
FROM departments d
JOIN dept_emp e ON d.dept_no = e.dept_no
GROUP BY d.dept_name
ORDER BY num_employees DESC
parsed_sql:
SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(e.emp_no) AS num_employees
FROM departments d
JOIN dept_emp e ON d.dept_no = e.dept_no
GROUP BY d.dept_name
ORDER BY num_employees DESC

question: Which departments currently have more than 10,000 employees?
raw_output:
SELECT d.dept_name FROM departments d
JOIN dept_emp de ON d.dept_no = de.dept_no
GROUP BY d.dept_no
HAVING COUNT(de.emp_no) > 10000
parsed_sql:
SELECT d.dept_name FROM departments d
JOIN dept_emp de ON d.dept_no = de.dept_no
GROUP BY d.dept_no
HAVING COUNT(de.emp_no) > 10000
